verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party Device Authorization plugin implementing the RFC 8628 code issuance and approval flow, explicitly aimed at CLI applications and other limited-input devices. The docs also note the flow can be tested immediately with the Better Auth CLI, which is the story's exact use case of authenticating CLIs without pasting long-lived secrets. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the device flow in real CLI or agent deployments, and explicit documentation of headless-agent usage beyond CLIs.
